The zones of limits, we often confront them
Invisible boundaries that often surpass us
Everyone has their limit, in different fields
And that's where our differences cause the most pain
Limits, barriers, we seek to surpass them
But sometimes, we hit impassable walls
The zones of limits, it's an unspoken pain
When we feel hindered in our most sensitive dreams
Life is full of zones of limits, it's true
Prohibitions, rules to respect
We try to push them back, to ignore them
But they are there, always present, to remind us
